title: Conversational Entity Memory
summary: This module provides tools for managing conversational memory by extracting and summarizing entities from chat history. It supports various storage backends for persisting entity data, including in-memory, Redis, Upstash Redis, and SQLite.

nodes.label: Manage Conversational Entities
nodes.title: ConversationEntityMemory
nodes.description: Extracts named entities from chat history, generates summaries using an LLM, and manages their persistence across conversations.

nodes.label: Large Language Model
nodes.title: BaseLanguageModel
nodes.description: Provides language understanding and generation capabilities for entity extraction and summarization tasks within the memory system.

nodes.label: Entity Extraction Prompt
nodes.title: BasePromptTemplate (Extraction)
nodes.description: A template used to instruct the LLM on how to identify and extract named entities from the recent conversational history.

nodes.label: Entity Summarization Prompt
nodes.title: BasePromptTemplate (Summarization)
nodes.description: A template used to guide the LLM in generating concise summaries for extracted entities based on the current chat context.

nodes.label: In-Memory Entity Storage
nodes.title: InMemoryEntityStore
nodes.description: A transient storage solution for entities, holding data only for the duration of the application's runtime. Used as the default entity store.

nodes.label: Redis Entity Storage
nodes.title: RedisEntityStore
nodes.description: Persists entity data using a Redis database, offering fast access and configurable time-to-live for entities and their summaries.

nodes.label: Upstash Redis Entity Storage
nodes.title: UpstashRedisEntityStore
nodes.description: Provides entity persistence via Upstash Redis, a serverless Redis solution, with built-in time-to-live management for entity data.

nodes.label: SQLite Entity Storage
nodes.title: SQLiteEntityStore
nodes.description: Stores entity data in a local SQLite database, ensuring persistence and safe query execution for entity management.

nodes.label: Conversational History
nodes.title: Chat History
nodes.description: The ongoing record of messages exchanged in a conversation, providing essential context for entity identification and summarization.

nodes.label: User Input
nodes.title: User Input
nodes.description: The current message or query provided by the user, which contributes to the conversational context and triggers memory updates.

nodes.label: LLM Response
nodes.title: LLM Response
nodes.description: The output generated by the Large Language Model in response to user input, which is processed to update entity memory.

groups.label: Surface Components
groups.title: Surface Components
groups.description: The primary interface for interacting with the entity memory system.

groups.label: Generative Components
groups.title: Generative Components
groups.description: Components responsible for generating text, such as LLMs and their associated prompts.

groups.label: Data Components
groups.title: Data Components
groups.description: Components involved in storing, retrieving, and managing data, including entity stores and conversational history.
